sk.overview: The overnight ocean and coastal cruise industry in India is a nascent, high-growth segment of cruise tourism. risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Heightened geopolitical tensions, evolving trade policies, supply chain disruptions, elevated public debt levels and global trade uncertainties are flagged as downside risks to the economic outlook the business operates in.
- Net profit after tax declined year-on-year due to higher operating costs, increased employee and maintenance expenses, and other cost escalations, indicating cost-side pressure on profitability.
- The company's hospitality business is concentrated in two hotels — the InterContinental at Marine Drive, Mumbai and The Mansion House at Alibaug — creating single-location/asset concentration risk.
- Management's own cautionary statement notes that MD&A forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties and actual results may differ materially.
- The Mansion House, Alibaug expansion is explicitly stated to be subject to timely execution and prevailing market conditions.
- Graviss Hotels and Resorts Limited and Graviss Restaurants Private Limited reported losses after taxation for the year, per the AOC-1 subsidiary statement.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Enhancing guest experiences through personalised and technology-enabled services.
- Strengthening digital platforms to improve customer engagement and direct bookings.
- Expanding food and beverage offerings and enhancing banquet and event capabilities.
- Improving operational efficiencies through effective cost management and process optimisation.
- Adopting sustainable and environmentally responsible business practices.
- Exploring strategic partnerships and business opportunities that create long-term value for stakeholders.
